out_type.description: (Optional) The specified output type of the operation (`int32` or `int64`). Defaults to `tf.int32`. (Note: there is an experimental flag, `tf_shape_default_int64` that changes the default to `tf.int64`. This is an unsupported, experimental setting that causes known breakages.)
constraints: out_type is either int32 or int64, defaults to tf.int32
name is an optional string parameter for naming the operation
input must be a Tensor or SparseTensor
